notes: Hourly labour costs from official statistics. Loaded cost = value × employer on-cost multiplier (1 when the statistic already includes employer costs). These are whole-economy or occupation-group averages, a proxy for the person doing the work today; replace with your own payroll figures where you have them.

staff.statistic: PLFS Annual Report 2025: average monthly earnings of regular wage/salaried employees (₹24,217 men, ₹18,353 women; simple mean ₹21,285, as no combined figure is published) ÷ 192 hours (48-hour week)

multiplier.basis: Employer EPF 12% plus about 1% for EDLI and administration charges, approximated (not verified against current EPFO rules).

staff.statistic: BLS Employer Costs for Employee Compensation: civilian workers, office and administrative support, total compensation per hour worked

engineer.statistic: BLS Employer Costs for Employee Compensation: civilian workers, professional and related occupations, total compensation per hour worked

multiplier.basis: Total compensation already includes benefits (wages are 70.0% of private-industry compensation, June 2026).

staff.statistic: Statistics Canada Labour Force Survey: average hourly wages of employees

multiplier.basis: Employer CPP, EI and other payroll costs, approximated at 10% (not verified against current CRA rates).

staff.statistic: ABS Average Weekly Earnings: full-time adult ordinary time earnings, seasonally adjusted (A$2,083.70 a week ÷ 38-hour week)

multiplier.basis: Superannuation guarantee 12% of ordinary time earnings from 1 July 2025 (payroll tax and workers' compensation not included).

staff.statistic: No official whole-economy wage statistic found; sample value
ONS Annual Survey of Hours and Earnings: median hourly earnings excluding overtime, full-time employees

multiplier.basis: Employer National Insurance 15% above £5,000 a year (13.1% of median full-time pay of £766.60/week) plus minimum employer pension 3% of earnings between £6,240 and £50,270 (2.5%).

staff.statistic: FSO Swiss Earnings Structure Survey: median gross monthly wage, full-time (CHF 7,024 ÷ 173.2 hours: 40-hour week × 4.33)

multiplier.basis: Employer social insurance (AHV/IV/EO, unemployment, occupational pension, accident), approximated at 15% (not verified).

staff.statistic: Eurostat average hourly labour cost (wages plus employer social contributions and other non-wage costs), whole economy excluding agriculture and public administration, enterprises with 10+ employees. Already fully loaded.

multiplier.basis: Labour cost already includes employer non-wage costs (24.8% of labour costs in the EU in 2025).
